c74object.name: flux.artnet.send
c74object.digest: Send DMX channel values from Max to Art-Net lighting devices and software over the network
c74object.description: Send DMX channel values from Max to Art-Net lighting devices and software over the network.

method.name: blackout
method.digest: blackout 1 sends zeros on every configured universe; blackout 0 restores the retained frames
method.description: blackout 1 sends zeros on every configured universe; blackout 0 restores the retained frames.

method.name: info
method.digest: Output the current host and, when it matches a discovered device, its MAC, names and output universes on the right outlet
method.description: Output the current host and, when it matches a discovered device, its MAC, names and output universes on the right outlet.

method.name: device
method.digest: Connect to a discovered device by name, or by name and IP address
method.description: Connect to a discovered device by name, or by name and IP address. A single IP address is also accepted.

method.name: devices
method.digest: Poll for Art-Net devices and output the full list on the right outlet after a 250 ms collection window
method.description: Poll for Art-Net devices and output the full list on the right outlet after a 250 ms collection window.

method.name: set
method.digest: Update the stored frame without transmitting
method.description: Update the stored frame without transmitting. Integers are 0-255; floats are normalized 0.0-1.0.

method.name: universe
method.digest: Write channel values in a selected universe
method.description: Write channel values in a selected universe. Integers are 0-255; floats are normalized 0.0-1.0.

method.name: bang
method.digest: Send the current frame for every configured universe immediately
method.description: Send the current frame for every configured universe immediately.

method.name: float
method.digest: Write one normalized channel value (0.0-1.0) at offset 0 of universe index 0
method.description: Write one normalized channel value (0.0-1.0) at offset 0 of universe index 0.

method.name: list
method.digest: Write channel values from offset 0 of universe index 0
method.description: Write channel values from offset 0 of universe index 0. Integers are 0-255; floats are normalized 0.0-1.0.

method.name: int
method.digest: Write one raw DMX channel value (0-255) at offset 0 of universe index 0
method.description: Write one raw DMX channel value (0-255) at offset 0 of universe index 0.

method.name: channel
method.digest: Write channel values from a channel offset
method.description: Write channel values from a channel offset. Integers are 0-255; floats are normalized 0.0-1.0.

attribute.name: discover
attribute.digest: When 1, poll for Art-Net devices every 3 seconds and output the full device list on the right outlet whenever it changes
attribute.description: When 1, poll for Art-Net devices every 3 seconds and output the full device list on the right outlet whenever it changes. Discovery temporarily shares UDP port 6454 with flux.artnet.receive.

attribute.name: framerate
attribute.digest: Transmission rate in frames per second
attribute.description: Transmission rate in frames per second. 0 means change-triggered transmission. Valid range: 0-1000.

attribute.name: host
attribute.digest: Unicast destination IP address or hostname
attribute.description: Unicast destination IP address or hostname. Leave empty to send to the broadcast address of every active IPv4 interface. Changing the host starts a silent ArtPoll probe and emits a connected message when a device replies.

attribute.name: quiet
attribute.digest: When 1, suppress console messages from this object
attribute.description: When 1, suppress console messages from this object. Right-outlet messages are unaffected.

attribute.name: universes
attribute.digest: Ordered list of zero-based Art-Net Port-Addresses (0-32767)
attribute.description: Ordered list of zero-based Art-Net Port-Addresses (0-32767). Channel writes spill into subsequent entries in this list.
